title: Demand Forecast Contract (DC-DEMAND-FORECAST-v1)
description: Demand-forecast contract (Sprint 09 v2 draft per design spec §3.3 / FR-FC-001..006). Contract only; ingestion in a later sprint. Follows the dc-demand-encounter-v1 envelope pattern. Represents 72h demand forecasts per hospital × specialty × hourly bucket, extending the reference ontology hcp:ForecastOutput ICE (covers=Specialty, validFor=TimeWindow, refreshCadence, producedBy=ModelRunId) — see docs/ontology/reference-layer.ttl and docs/ontology/crosswalk.md v0.2.0. specialtyId links to dim_specialty (DC-MASTER-02). ADR-0013 westus2 demo-scope exception applies at the ingestion layer for synthetic data only; PROD PHI paths remain gated on Swiss residency per ADR-0003/0004. ADR-0016 gate 1: _pseudonymisation_flag=true is explicit at the dataset envelope for demo-scope contracts.

_pseudonymisation_flag.description: ADR-0016 gate 1: demo-scope dc-*.schema.json contracts must explicitly declare that all record identifiers are pseudonymised (no PHI). Enforced by policy_gate.py in the demo-scope profile. Forecast records contain no patient identifiers by construction; flag is set true for envelope consistency across dc-*.schema.json contracts.

forecastId.description: Unique forecast identifier. Maps to hcp:ForecastOutput in the reference ontology.

specialtyId.description: Composite hospital×specialty key from dim_specialty (DC-MASTER-02); e.g., H_USZ__SPEC_INNERE. Maps to hcp:Specialty via covers=Specialty.

validFrom.description: Start of the forecast validity window (inclusive).

validUntil.description: End of the forecast validity window (exclusive); design spec §3.3 mandates a 72h window.

refreshCadenceMinutes.description: Cadence in minutes at which the forecast is refreshed (default 60).

expectedCount.description: Expected demand count for the hourly bucket.

confidenceIntervalLower.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval.

confidenceIntervalUpper.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval; must be >= confidenceIntervalLower (enforced at ingestion).

producedBy.description: Model run identifier (producedBy=ModelRunId per design spec §3.3).

modelVersion.description: SemVer of the forecasting model that produced this output.
